title: Task lifecycle, contributor guide and pre-flight check
text: Every task page now shows its five stages, from proposal to release. A new contributor guide and a task PR pre-flight check help authors turn approved proposals into tasks.

title: 19 proposals from 9 researchers across 7 domains
text: The task board now holds 19 scientific proposals awaiting domain review, from quantum many-body physics to immunology and battery science.

title: Authors revise proposals on the site
text: Authors can edit their proposal on its task page with a live preview; saving updates the GitHub Discussion at the same time.

title: AI4S-Benchmark opens its public site
text: The benchmark's public presentation, task explorer and submission portal are now live. Task proposals are open via GitHub.
